text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
My voice has completely recovered...
But as for my running...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Goddammit...!
One more set, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ngggggh!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: (My heart wants to run so desperately. And yet... and yet my legs won't!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once the distance goes beyond a certain point,
her acceleration suddenly falls flat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Epiglottic entrapment was a heavy canopy that put a lid
not only on her abilities,
but on her spirits as well...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*... In the end...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Turns out I didn't understand anything myself.
Even after acting all high and mighty lecturing El.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yes, back during summer training camp...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's true, El. Your talent is certainly
splendid. However...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Long-nose! You mustn't get arrogant.
You must never forget to consider the feelings
and circumstances of those less fortunate..."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Things that come naturally to you
can be struggles that cause other people grief."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't imagine it at all.
Just how painful it is when your abilities fall short...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"This frustration, this helplessness...
Truly an unknown taste.
I'll have to redraw the map of the world from scratch..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl stands completely crushed.
And right past her side—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I've got to polish my start dash.
More, even more...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Who was that Umamusume...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Not good enough yet.
At this speed, I'll just get caught again right away...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Leading wire-to-wire in the Mile Championship...
is far beyond me. I have to change myself somehow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the training grounds, there were other Umamusume
who were also aiming for the Mile Championship.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her fellow front-runner, Silence Suzuka,
seemed to be struggling, unable to find her ideal running style.
What's more—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh... I gotta do my best, gotta do my best!
Stretch it out like mochi...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, this isn't buono at all~. The old me
had way more of a chanko flavor to it~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono is an Umamusume with a big heart and a big frame.
She excels from sprint to mile distances, but lately, she seems to be in a slump.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This place is just like...
"Hell," isn't it, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Hell... you mean, like, actual hell?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, a hangout for those who have lost hope.
Everyone is looking for a way out, not a dream...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"And I'm one of them.
Somehow, by the time of the Mile CS..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, everyone had their own hardships. The hidden side
of the glittering Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A period of slump comes for everyone without fail.
And unless you break out of it—"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'll try experimenting a bit more,
using my runs up to now as clues.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I might never find it.
But maybe, just maybe, it's out there somewhere.
A running style that's truly my own.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I... I have to take it back too.
My own buono...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So I can run like I used to.
I just need to remember the recipe from back then.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Everyone's... desperate, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"There's no choice but to do it, to carve out my own path.
That's why I kept challenging it desperately, over and over..."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Can I really do it too? Even after a sudden illness
cast me down to rock bottom...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I think. Silence Suzuka,
and Hishi Akebono. Compared to them,
Seeking the Pearl is...
choice_data_list: It might actually make it easier to find our way.
It might actually make it easier to find our way.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Huh? Easier to look for?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl clearly has something
that sets her apart from the other two. That is—
choice_data_list: Because there's no turning back now

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: There is no turning back... Turning back...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ah... Yes. Running like I used to... That's the one thing that's impossible for me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It seems you've realized. Indeed, having refused surgery,
there is no simple recovery for Seeking the Pearl.
In other words—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was no choice but to forge a new way of running.
The only path—was forward.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Okay. If a breakthrough is absolutely necessary, then that actually makes things simple and clear. I appreciate it.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's do this, Trainer! That's right—the deeper
the despair, the greater the hope waiting to be found!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And—one more important thing. One who has never known illness cannot truly speak of illness.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"If I can still run even in this state, it'll surely
send a message to people all over the world
fighting illness!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And thus began the days of trial and error.
And finally, the clue we discovered was...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
HAAAAAAA! More!
Save more in your legs, and then...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Now's the time!
If my stamina won't hold out, I can't win a battle of all-around ability.
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Strengthen explosive power even more! The only way
is to apply short-distance running to the mile!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAA!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To overcome the limitations of distance, her instantaneous acceleration
and speed became rapidly refined.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A cracked pearl. Yet Seeking the Pearl
overcame it—and began finding her brilliance
as a brand-new gem.
